name: io.github.Atlasent/mcp-server
title: AtlaSent MCP Server
description: AtlaSent for AI agents: with an API key, actions wait for approval with signed proof. No key: demo.

environmentVariables.name: ATLASENT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: AtlaSent API key: sign up free at console.atlasent.io and choose Connect an AI agent. Leave blank for the local demo mode.

environmentVariables.name: ATLASENT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: AtlaSent API base URL. Defaults to the hosted SaaS endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: ATLASENT_MODE
environmentVariables.description: remote (default when an API key is set) or local (in-process rules engine, no API calls)
